_README: Tauri auto-updater manifest. Edit the placeholder fields below before going live. Each `signature` is the contents of the matching .sig file produced by `tauri build` when TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set (paste the raw text — Tauri base64-decodes it itself). Each `url` must be a publicly downloadable artifact. Bump `version` and `pub_date` for every release.
notes: Skillset 1.1.0 — formerly PromptPack. New brand, in-app Skill Chat, Skill Flow orchestration, encrypted Skill Preset (MVP), and a full migration from pmtpk.com to skillset.so. Sign in with your existing email — your packs and credits move with you.
